# Zcash Swap

> Zcash Swap is a non-custodial interface for exchanging ZEC to and from BTC, ETH, USDT and other coins through instant-exchange routes. The user sends funds to a deposit address and receives them at their own wallet address. The interface never holds private keys or funds.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Zcash swaps are cross-chain exchanges through instant-exchange routes, not on-chain DEX trades.
- Transparent addresses start with t- and are public; shielded z- and unified u- addresses encrypt transaction details.
- Each route decides which Zcash address types it accepts for deposit and payout, so check before sending.
- A refund address receives funds back if an exchange cannot complete, and routes wait for network confirmations before payout.
- ZEC network fees are small and paid in ZEC; the quote also includes the route fee and the payout network fee.

## Pages

- Zcash Swap & learn: https://swap-zec.github.io/
- Legal: https://swap-zec.github.io/legal.html
